full_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input1 is the edit target, #108 Otus rutilus v19 concept plate. Input2 is a supporting biological reference photograph by Frank Vassen, 4 Dec2013 Andasibe (CC BY2.0), juvenile age and flight unknown. Rebuild ONLY the centre juvenile and its immediate foot contact, using the photograph's real proportions: tall oval fluffy body, head turned in three-quarter profile right, brown-buff subtly mottled fine down filaments with sparse straight wisps, a darker small facial mask, yellow iris with dark pupil and discreet pink eyelid. Replace the entire artificial looped/woolly feather surface, not just blur it: fine irregular straight feather barbs, NO circles, loops, repeated curls or knitted yarn. Small partly concealed wings, no invented exposed mature primaries, secure two feet on branch. Photo is morphology/pose reference only; do not paste photograph or bring extra objects. Retain established polished stylized 3D pet-art visual language, adults, adult size relationship, forest, gold plaques, typography/layout and support branch. The adult female's average extra mass does not imply a new linear height difference. Header version v20. Bottom text remains CONCEPT · PERCH ONLY · FLIGHT UNVERIFIED · SCIENCE PENDING. Centre label JUVENILE AGE UNKNOWN. No hatchling claim. Preserve other text verbatim.
